Clause-②: yes (widening) — two new optional `ListViewProps` on the `@object-ui/plugin-list` entry, `toolbarTrailing` and `conditionRowEnd`; new keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` locale (`listConditions.chips.sort` / `.filter` / `.sortedBy`, `list.viewSettings`, `list.optionsMenu.shownColumns` / `.addColumn`); nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none
Flow: dev-thread rule (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z 「所有 p1 都按照新规则执行」): the card thread builds itself; L1 and the isolated L2 run in parallel at hand-back, the maintainer's 09:22Z ruling for every p1 card (deviates from contract-review.md:18 until the skill card lands). This card is a p2 child of epic #35547, run the same way (Sales 2026-11-20 16:32Z 「专题任务p1p2 都处理」).

## 维护者速读
- 用户在控制台的对象列表上方会看到两行，不再是三行：第一行是「对象名 / 视图名 ▾ · 视图设置」，右端依次是搜索、新建和最右边的「⋮ 更多」；第二行常驻排序和筛选标签，加条件后表格不再往下跳。
- 这是「列表页重做」专题的一部分，也做了 #35678 原来那条「更多放最右、同一个图标」；#35678 已改写成「底部浮出操作条」，这个 PR 合并不关闭它，选中时右端换成「已选」那一面会由它之后替换。
- 「打开记录」设置已随 #35910 去掉（点名称开整页、悬停图标开侧栏），视图设置里不再有这一项。
- 出错时用户会找不到原来的「筛选 N / 排序 N」按钮；改动只在界面上，撤回这个 PR 就恢复原样，不动任何已存数据。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

The console object list drew three rows above the table: a page bar (object name, ⋮ More, New), the view bar (Filter N, Sort N, Options, search) and a condition row that appeared only once a condition was set. It now draws two.

**Row 1, the view bar** (`ListView` toolbar row, hosted by `app-shell`):
- `[icon Object / View N ▾] [View settings ▾] … [search] [toolbar actions] [+ New] [⋮]`.
- The object's icon and plural name lead the bar as the page's `h1` (`ObjectViewBarObjectName`, `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`). The page bar is not drawn when the view bar hosts these (`ListViewBarHostContext`); every other host of `ObjectViewPageHeader` is unchanged.
- The right end is `ObjectViewBarTrailing`: the list's search, then `ObjectViewPageBarActions` (schema toolbar, create, then ⋮ More last; #35678).
- While rows are selected the end shows the selection face (objectstack#35554's `useListPageBarHost` slot). ⋮ keeps its place and icon in both faces: `SelectionPageBar`'s overflow is now `MoreVertical`, the same as the page's. The search and page acts are hidden, not unmounted, while selecting.

**Row 2, the condition row** (`ConditionChipRow`, resident now):
- Nothing set: dashed 「Sort」 and 「Filter」.
- A sort of any number of levels is ONE chip, 「Sorted by X」 plus 「+N」. It opens every level in one panel, #35876's `sort-chip-panel` from #35909 (add a level, reorder by the handle), and never flips a direction itself. With no sort, the dashed 「Sort」 opens main's `SortPanel`. Neither panel is rebuilt here (#35876 owns their content).
- Each filter is its own chip with ×, then 「+」.
- The right end is the host's `conditionRowEnd`: 「Personalized」 and 「Reset」 while the list differs from its view.
- The row is one line (`flex-nowrap`, sideways scroll) and is always drawn, so the table's Y does not move when the first condition is set or after Reset.

**View settings** (was 「Options」):
- Sits right after the view switcher.
- The first level is the content itself: view name, shown columns (drag, eye), 「+ Add column」, then Layout, Group, Row height and Row color where offered.
- Its footer keeps Save, Restore defaults and export.
- No Open records section: #35910 (#35854) retired it, and the merge took it out of this panel.
- The More level (with its inline edit switch) and Refresh are gone.

**Narrow widths** (container queries on the list root, `@container/list`), down to 640:
1. 「View settings」 folds to its icon.
2. Then the word 「Personalized」 goes.
3. Then 「Reset」 folds to its icon.

New host props on `ListView` (optional, so the Clause-② widening): `toolbarTrailing(tools)` for the bar's right end, given the list's search, and `conditionRowEnd` for the condition row's right end. A host that passes neither gets the search alone at the end and the row's own Reset.

i18n: `listConditions.chips.{sort,filter,sortedBy}`, `list.viewSettings`, `list.optionsMenu.{shownColumns,addColumn}` in all 11 locale packs.

## For the phone cards

Ruling record 7045325067 on #35880 says each panel's content must be a component that does not depend on its container, with value/onChange passed in. These are the parts a phone sheet should mount as they are. None of them knows about the popover around it.

| Part | Component (file) | Interface |
|---|---|---|
| Condition row | `ConditionChipRow` (`plugin-list/src/conditions/ListConditionControls.tsx`) | `sort`, `filters` + `onFiltersChange(next)`, `sortFields`/`filterFields`, `renderSortPanel(close)` (no sort yet), `renderSortLevels()` (every level, a sort in force), `renderAdvanced()`, `end`, `filterOffered`, `onReset` |
| Sort panel | `SortPanel` (same file) | `value: SortItem[]`, `onChange(next)`, `onDone()`, `fields`, `shownFields`, `footer`, `renderAdvanced()` |
| Filter panel | `FilterPanel` (same file) | `value: FilterBuilderRowGroup`, `onChange(next)`, `fields`, `shownFields`, `renderAdvanced()`, `conditionId` |
| View settings content | `ViewSettingsContent` (`plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`) | `ViewSettingsPopoverProps` (each setting as value + setter: `groupingConfig`/`setGroupingConfig`, `density`, `hiddenFields`/`updateHiddenFields`, `fieldOrder`/`onFieldOrderChange`, `viewName`, …) plus `closeMenu()`; `ViewSettingsPopover` is only the trigger + popover around it |
| Column list | `FieldList` (`plugin-list/src/conditions/FieldList.tsx`) | `fields`, `shownFields`, `order` + `onOrderChange(order)`, `onHide(name)`, `onShow(name)`, `onPick(field)`, `searchable` |

Kept separate: nothing. This PR builds no bottom sheet and no staging layer, as the ruling says.

## Tests

- After merging main with #35909 (43ff7948), the one chip opens #35876's panel of every level:
  - `conditionPanels.ts` `openAdvancedSort()` and the two local helpers in `fieldListRead-11984` and `harness` read `sort-chip-panel` when a sort is in force, else step from the field list's footer as before; `withheldFields-34901` the same.
  - `headerMenuSort-35876`, the three chip cases: the chip is `condition-sort` (`data-levels`), its text names the first level after a move.
  - `fieldListRead-11984`: the Sort picker's field-list case mounts with no sort (the dashed 「Sort」 opens the list).
  - `conditionRow-35549` 「Reset clears the reader's filter and keeps the sort the view saved」: the view's sort is the one chip.
  - `listConditions.test.tsx`: #35909's 「sort chips come before filter chips…」 case is the one-chip case (before the filter chips, opens `sort-chip-panel`, writes no sort), and a new case pins that the dashed 「Sort」 opens the sort panel.
- Open records: `optionsMenu-35551` keeps main's 「no Open records section」 case, opened on the panel's first level (there is no More level); main deleted the two `recordOpen-26681` files.
- e2e (the specs that read class strings and test ids out of the sources):
  - `list-condition-row-35549`: the row is resident at 40 px; nothing set shows the dashed Sort and Filter (`data-levels` 0, `data-empty`); a sort of any depth is the one `condition-sort` chip (「Sorted by Amount」 + 「+1」); Reset and × return to the empty face. Reworked on #35909's version after the main merge (43ff7948): the chip opens `sort-chip-panel`, 「Add sort」 there adds the second level, a real drag of a `sort-builder-handle` reorders, and a header click opens `column-context-menu` and sorts nothing until 「Sort descending」.
  - `list-toolbar-view-name-phone`: the touch-size pin now reads the 视图设置 trigger in `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (the old pattern no longer matched anything and threw at load).
  - `list-frame-geometry-35548`: no page bar; the view bar carries the object name and icon, the switcher and 视图设置, with search, New and ⋮ at its end; the condition row is resident (`min-h-10 flex-nowrap`); thead at Y 128.
  - `list-left-edge-35663`: the object icon in the view bar and ⋮ at its end sit 16 px from the column edge, the same as the select-all box.
</details>

<details><summary>Voided (the behaviour they pinned is removed by the card)</summary>

- `ListView.toolbarIconButtons-12695.test.tsx` (deleted): the Filter N / Sort N icon buttons are gone.
- Cases dropped where only the removed controls were pinned:
  - `conditionRow-35549`: 3 cases (per-level sort chips, the row hidden when empty).
  - `displayPopover-12423`: the footer Refresh.
  - `phoneSortSearch-28911`: 2 cases (Sort inside the Display panel on the phone).
  - `phoneWidth-29074`: 4 cases (the phone bar's own Sort trigger).
  - `toolbarAccessibleNames-12500`: the below-sm active filter count.
  - `toolbarRows-27520`: 2 cases (the badge counts).
  - `viewBarLeading-35548`: the condition row empty.
  - `listConditions.test.tsx`: 5 cases (per-level sort chips, move and flip).
  - e2e `list-condition-row-35549`: the drag-reorder case of the per-level chips.
</details>

Added: `listConditions.test.tsx` 「ConditionChipRow — the resident row of the two-row toolbar (objectstack#35878)」, 7 cases: the dashed empty face, one sort chip with +N, filter chips with ×, then +, `end` in place of Reset, `filterOffered`, and nowrap.

Checklist (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`), three items whose wording this PR makes false, each with a history entry ref #35878:

- `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` → revision 13: steps[6], [8], [10], [11] and acceptance[10], [11] reworded. There is no page bar above the list; 「Options」 is 「View settings」 beside the view name with no More level; the condition row is resident at 40 px; ⋮ More is last at the view bar's end; the object icon leads the view bar.
- `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` → revision 11: steps[1], [2] and acceptance[0] place the selection face at the view bar's right end.
